name: pykeen-data-preparation-v2
instr:
Restore the documented behavior of PyKEEN's data preparation subsystem, which is the code under `src/pykeen/datasets/` and `src/pykeen/triples/` together with the documentation that describes it.

That documentation is the authority: the user guide, tutorial, reference and example pages under `docs/source/` that cover this subsystem, and the public docstrings, doctests, signatures, and attribute comments in the two module trees themselves. Read it, compare every behavioral contract it states against the implementation, and restore all behavior affected by the drift.

Nothing here tells you which files, functions or behaviors the drift touches, or how many there are; determining that from the documentation is the task. Preserve public APIs and behavior outside this subsystem. Work offline.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-front investigation and decisions, and it should not be rewritten to match whatever the implementation turns into afterwards. Once it is done, implement the plan.
